$schema_note: Machine-readable compatibility data for this project. Grow this via PRs - see CONTRIBUTING.md. Three confidence tiers, kept deliberately separate: confirmed_variants (directly tested in this repo), community_reported (a specific public forum report, not independently tested or verified by this repo), and unconfirmed_or_open (open questions / unresolved problems). Do not merge these tiers - the distinction between 'we tested this' and 'someone else reported this' is the whole point.

bulletin.title: Toyota RAV4 with navigation system, Corolla SD/HB/TS with navigation system and without it (with Panasonic, Harman) - Retrofit

confirmed_variants.notes: Both DA30 and DA31 kwi files embed version 01023 for this model - either should work as the swap source.

community_reported.source: Toyota Owners Club forum, user Alcar and others, thread 193487 - NOT independently tested or verified by this repo
community_reported.notes: Community route used a manually-reconstructed folder from a US Camry retrofit package plus hex-edited identity files, not the official bulletin's EU USB3 package directly. The version numbers (1020/1023) and the phaseup.dat issue match what this repo found independently on a different DCU part number via the official package - that overlap is the useful signal here, not an independent confirmation of this exact Camry variant.

unconfirmed_or_open.note: RAV4 user 'dpm' on the same forum thread hit 'insufficient memory, see your dealer' during the MEU update (1120->1170), unresolved. Not reproduced or explained in this repo.
Reported on the forum as working with the same method; part numbers not independently verified by this repo.

No evidence this DCU has native WiFi hardware for direct wireless CarPlay - the official retrofit is wired-only. Third-party wireless CarPlay dongles (e.g. CarlinKit) that sit on the existing USB-A port and only require working wired CarPlay are a plausible path, since that precondition is now met, but none has been tested on this hardware yet. Untested, not confirmed either way - see README's 'Wireless CarPlay' section.

contribute: Open a PR adding your confirmed variant to confirmed_variants, or an issue if you're not sure how. Include: exact Model ID / Parts No. from the unit's own Model Information screen, before/after Audio build numbers, and whether CarPlay was confirmed working.
